title: Generic containers
hints: `if (r.ok) return { ok: true, value: fn(r.value) }; return r;` works because a failed `Result<T>` has the same shape as a failed `Result<U>`.
`Number(text)` gives `NaN` for text that is not a number; check `Number.isInteger` too for an age.
requirements: `type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string }`.
`function mapResult<T, U>(r: Result<T>, fn: (value: T) => U): Result<U>` changes the value only when `ok`.
stretch: Give the queue a maximum size as a constructor parameter, and make `enqueue` return a `Result<number>` with the new size.
